title: Effects of 8-week moderate-intensity jogging on gene expression in healthy Thai male volunteers
description:
This study investigated the effects of an 8-week moderate-intensity jogging program on blood lipid profiles, oxidative stress, and gene expression in healthy men volunteers.

This study investigated the effects of an 8-week moderate-intensity jogging program on blood lipid profiles, oxidative stress, and gene expression in healthy, sedentary Thai male volunteers. Using a combined biochemical and RNA-Sequencing approach, the study aimed to identify the molecular mechanisms underlying exercise-induced cardiometabolic adaptations in an Asian population a demographic underrepresented in exercise genomics research. These findings provide population-specific insights relevant to evidence-based exercise prescription and the identification of molecular biomarkers of aerobic training adaptation.
